# Fitness Habit Tracker: Auto

> Fitness Habit Tracker is a fitness streak app for iPhone and Apple Watch that finds your workout, step and sleep streaks in Apple Health automatically. Private.

## App

- [Fitness Streak App for iPhone | Fitness Habit Tracker: Auto](https://jackwallner.com/ios/fitness-streaks/index.html.md): Fitness Habit Tracker is a fitness streak app for iPhone and Apple Watch that finds your workout, step and sleep streaks in Apple Health automatically. Private.

## Guides

- [Apple Watch Streak Broken? How to Keep a Workout Streak](https://jackwallner.com/ios/fitness-streaks/apple-watch-streak-broken.html.md): What Apple documents about protecting an Apple Watch award streak (Pause Rings, up to 90 days), what a missed day really costs, and how to keep a streak.
- [Streaks App Alternatives: 5 Habit Trackers Compared](https://jackwallner.com/ios/fitness-streaks/streaks-app-alternative.html.md): Looking for a Streaks app alternative? Five iPhone habit trackers compared: Streaks, HabitKit, Habitify, Gentler Streak and Fitness Habit Tracker: Auto.
